paragraphs.source_en: Using Money to Demonstrate Value One technique I like for gauging value is to see if the user would be willing to pay for it, even if you have no intention of charging them for it. We’re looking for the user to pull out his or her credit card right then and there and ask to buy the product (but we don’t really want the card information). If it’s an expensive product for businesses—beyond what someone would put on a credit card—you can ask people if they will sign a “non-binding letter of intent to buy” which is a good indicator that people are serious.
